title: BSE volumes ease after sharp rebound; CAS remains in focus: Nuvama
text: BSE volumes ease after sharp rebound; CAS remains in focus: Nuvama. For FY27 to date, BSE’s ADPTV is around Rs 26,200 crore, while its ADPTV market share is around 35.2%. Its premium-to-notional turnover ratio is around 12.4 basis points, compared with 17.2 basis points for the industry.
